title: Rolling 30-Day Patient Visits
scenario: Calculate the total sum of patient visits in a 30-day rolling window per clinic.
tableSchema: visits (clinic_id INT, visit_date DATE, patient_count INT)
hint: Use RANGE BETWEEN with an INTERVAL.
correctQuery: SELECT clinic_id, visit_date, SUM(patient_count) OVER(PARTITION BY clinic_id ORDER BY visit_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '29 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30d_visits FROM visits;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE visits (clinic_id INT, visit_date DATE, patient_count INT);
